title: Model-by-cell NRMSE heatmap and per-root structured-minus-ridge differences
population: Four reference models evaluated on three fixed roots from one public synthetic generator.
metric: Stored mean cellwise NRMSE (six cells x four models), stored six-cell mean, and structured minus ridge NRMSE per root and cell.
grouping: Six outcome-horizon cells x four models; panel b differences of recorded root values.
sample_sizes: Each root has 16 camps and 4,000 rows per outcome-horizon cell; 18 root-cell differences.
uncertainty: No interval or test; descriptive differences of recorded values. No ridge-versus-structured interval was recorded.
caption_tex: Model-by-cell error heatmap. (a) Stored mean NRMSE across the three evaluation roots for six outcome-horizon cells (rows) and four reference models (columns); the bottom row is the equal-weight six-cell mean. Lower is better. Colour is centred at NRMSE\,=\,1, the value of a cell-mean predictor: blue is below 1 and red above 1. Outlined cells are lowest in their row. (b) Descriptive structured-minus-ridge NRMSE for each root (A circle, B square, C triangle); positive values mean ridge was lower. Ridge was lower in all 18 root-cell comparisons (0.025 to 0.047). No interval or test is implied, and no ridge-versus-structured confidence interval was recorded.
